description: Source code for OpenSSL extension creation utilities, handling X509 extensions configuration, parsing, and encoding.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_nconf
methods.description: Creates an X509 extension from configuration parameters, handling critical and generic extension types.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_nconf_nid
methods.description: Creates an X509 extension from configuration parameters using a specific NID.

methods.name: do_ext_nconf
methods.description: Internal function to generate an extension based on configuration, extension NID, and type.

methods.name: do_ext_i2d
methods.description: Converts internal extension structure to DER and creates an X509 extension.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_i2d
methods.description: Converts internal extension structure to X509 extension using extension NID.

methods.name: v3_check_critical
methods.description: Checks if extension string indicates criticality.

methods.name: v3_check_generic
methods.description: Checks if extension string indicates a generic extension type and returns the type.

methods.name: v3_generic_extension
methods.description: Creates a generic extension, handling DER and ASN1 types.

methods.name: generic_asn1
methods.description: Generates ASN1 type DER encoding from string value.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_add_nconf_sk
methods.description: Adds extensions to a stack from configuration section.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_add_nconf
methods.description: Adds extensions to a certificate from configuration section.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_CRL_add_nconf
methods.description: Adds extensions to a CRL from configuration section.

methods.name: X509V3_EXT_REQ_add_nconf
methods.description: Adds extensions to a certificate request from configuration section.

methods.name: X509V3_set_nconf
methods.description: Sets the configuration database in context.

methods.name: X509V3_set_ctx
methods.description: Initializes the context for extension creation.
